name: Hundred Finance Gnosis ERC-677 transfer-hook reentrancy

classification.summary: Hundred's Compound-fork markets for Gnosis ERC-677 tokens transferred the underlying before updating borrow accounting, so the token's transferAndCall hook re-entered borrow() and drained several markets (compound-finance/compound-protocol issue 141).

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/hundred-finance.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: market 0x243E33aa7f6787154a8E59d3C27a66db3F8818ee created 2021-04-25T10:52:00Z by 0xb16a11442878d6f1ef202ae63233a7c13e98fd7f, not the attack-tx sender 0xd041ad9aae5cf96b21c3ffcb303a0cb80779e358. This is a Compound-fork delegator, so besides checking for EIP-1967 Upgraded events (none) the NewImplementation(address,address) log was also queried: the only one is at the creation block 15722098, so the executing code was 324.0 days old. The PoC also names markets 0xe4e43864ea18d5e5211352a4b810383460ab7fcc, 0x8e15a22853a0a60a0fbb0d875055a8e66cff0235 and 0x090a00a2de0ea83def700b5e216f87a5d4f394fe. Loss $1.7 million per the DeFiHackLabs 2022 index entry for this PoC. Distinct from the 2023-04 Hundred Finance row on optimism already in this file.

re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis. CErc20Delegator: `implementation` is storage slot 18 (slot 17 is `underlying` = 0xddafbb505ad214d7b80b1f830fccc89b60fb7a83). Slot 18 held 0xfcd8570ad81e6c77b8d252bebeba62ed980bd64d continuously over a 25-point probe of [15722098, 21120320] and the only NewImplementation(address,address) on the delegator is the 0x0 -> 0xfcd8570a write in its creation block. callTracer on the exploit tx confirms the delegator delegatecalls only that implementation, which itself has zero DELEGATECALL opcodes.
